subject: Linguistics
title: Communities of Practice
description: A fast breakdown of Communities of Practice for builders.

hook.text: A group of skateboarders develops shared slang, storytelling styles, and even pronunciation quirks.

buildup.text: A community of practice is a group united by shared activities and the language that develops around them.

discovery.text: Eckert studied high school 'jocks' and 'burnouts'—each group used distinct vowel pronunciations.

twist.text: Linguistic differences within a school were bigger than those across geographic regions.

climax.text: Identity isn't just reflected in language—it's actively constructed through linguistic choices.

punchline.text: You are what you speak—and you speak what you do.

quiz.question: What is a community of practice?
options: A group united by shared activities and language
